subject: MAP rebaseline & conditional close plan — BrightPath Health
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpathhealth.com
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + procurement timeline

Jordan — thanks for the MAP draft earlier. Quick note from procurement: our security team still needs a SOC2 evidence bundle and the external vendor attestation before we can sign. That adds an estimated 2–3 weeks on our side. I attached BrightPath_SOW_v3.pdf with the redlines procurement requested.

Can Redwood accommodate a formal rebaseline of the MAP and shift the close by ~21 days? We want to keep the canary window tight and would prefer a conditional close (sign + pilot) if possible.

Short list of blockers from our side:
- SOC2 evidence (controls matrix + assessor report)
- Finalized data-retention appendix for PHI pathways
- Exec signature availability (week of Sept 20)

Would appreciate a short note back with options (extension, pilot terms, credit) so I can set expectations with my CFO.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Director of IT Programs | BrightPath Health
(attachment: BrightPath_SOW_v3.pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + procurement timeline

Emily — I appreciate the heads up and the SOW with annotations. We can definitely work through a conditional close that preserves your pilot window while we finish the SOC2 evidence path.

Proposed options (short bullets):
1) 21-day rebaseline to formal close: extend target close to Sept 29, with an interim pilot start (limited seats) on Sept 20. Redwood provides a 10% service credit if final onboarding slips past Oct 6.
2) Conditional close now: exec signature + DocuSign for SOW, with a documented MAP milestone that ties production traffic to receipt of SOC2 artifacts. Pilot starts upon signature; final acceptance tied to SOC2 evidence.
3) Short pilot only: 30-day pilot with no financial commitment until SOC2 evidence delivered; Redwood offers an onboarding rate cap for fairness.

I'm looping in Laura (CS lead) and Rishi (SRE/SE) to confirm operational feasibility and to update the MAP spreadsheet. If procurement can share the specific SOC2 artifacts list (Emily or Tom), Rishi will confirm whether any interim compensating controls are acceptable.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura to update MAP with milestone dates + ownership (by EOD tomorrow).
- Emily to share the SOC2 artifact checklist or point to a shared folder.
- Quick exec alignment call if you want to lock a conditional close (15–20m).

Happy to take whatever option you prefer — call out which and we’ll action it.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
(office) 415-555-0142
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + procurement timeline

Emily / Jordan — attached is a cleaned MAP with the three options Jordan outlined. I mapped owners and acceptance criteria so we can use it as a working plan. A few notes inline:
- If procurement needs the SOC2 report itself, we can provide an assessor-signed SR (redwood-thirdparty-assessor.pdf) under NDA.
- Rishi confirmed a staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) is operationally feasible if we get the artifact list by Sept 7.
- I added a contingency lane for a 30-day pilot in case exec signatures slip beyond Sept 20.

Attachment: MAP_BrightPath_v2.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@brightpathhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + procurement timeline

Emily — quick technical note on SOC2 artifacts. If procurement can provide the controls matrix and the last two quarters of exception logs and the assessor summary, we can provision an isolated test VPC and scoped logging (customer-controlled retention) within 5 business days. Missing details that delay us:
- Specific encryption key management requirements (KMS/HSM preference)
- Any additional data residency constraints beyond standard US regions

If you drop the artifact list in the Drive link Laura shared, I’ll triage and confirm exact gating items. If those two KMS/residency items are requirements, we may need a short engineering change (1–2 weeks).

—Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + procurement timeline

Looping in a short note from an account-management perspective — BrightPath is high priority for Q4 ARR coverage. Procurement-driven slip is a known risk; I recommend we (a) approve a single 21-day rebaseline as Jordan suggested, and (b) offer a one-time onboarding credit (5% of first-quarter committed spend) if the final close falls after Oct 6.

If leadership wants to escalate for a tighter concession instead of credit, I can raise to VP Sales for approval. For now, please treat the 21-day rebaseline as our default path unless BrightPath picks conditional close.

Marissa Cole
Senior AM | Redwood Inference
From: Emily Park <emily.park@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpathhealth.com, Tom Everett <tom.everett@brightpathhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + procurement timeline

Thanks, Jordan / Laura / Rishi / Marissa. We reviewed the options internally and are OK with the 21-day rebaseline (target close Sept 29) + pilot start Sept 20. Procurement will upload the SOC2 checklist and the SOW redlines to the Drive folder Laura shared by EOD tomorrow.

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can Redwood confirm the conditional canary steps in writing (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and attach them to the MAP as an operational appendix?
2) Please confirm the proposed onboarding credit language (5% of Q1 committed spend) in the SOW amendment so procurement can sign quickly.

If both items are in the amended SOW, procurement expects to route for exec signature next week. I’ll drop the DocuSign contact for Tom once you send the amendment.

Emily
(attachment: SOC2_evidence_request.xlsx)
